classification_rationale: Established methodological standard (B); its use as a subsystem-boundary design analogy is inspiration only (D face).
implementation_seam: Schema-level requirement that physics-model records carry a non-empty scales-and-validity field (presence, never truth)
legitimate_uses: Requiring every physics-model record to declare scales, validity limits and what is integrated out
minimal_evidence_before_implementation: None beyond ordinary test evidence: the discipline constrains records, not physics
neutral_name: Effective-field-theory power counting, scale separation and controlled cutoffs
